There are people kicking dirt around this little planet now who know how to mass produce graphene. It is ridiculously simple. So much so that if it's ever adopted, people will facepalm.

But none of them bother to share their work because science has become such a crony-dominated thing. It goes back to the same problem that leads to bunk research being published in peer-reviewed journals.

Those who are good with people have spent their time learning to socialize and socially engineer outcomes they desire. Those who are good with math, physics, and chemistry have spent their time learning math, physics, and chemistry. Guess which one has the connections to get recognition and which one gets their work rejected without it ever being read by anybody.

If people in general knew how many people are sitting back laughing at articles like this one, half the world's media-aware population would get angry and the other half would join in the laughing. Don't ask me to explain it, because I won't disrespect anybody by putting it out there. But I will give a clue.

Some years ago, a young researcher demonstrated that graphene can be produced for research purposes with nothing but pencil graphite and scotch tape. That researcher was insulted, called stupid, and laughed at for years until, lo and behold, some researcher people arbitrarily chose to respect verified the work. Yet all the people who claim to show us how to produce this material in higher quantities claim that energy expensive or complicated processes are required. See if you can spot where there's something wrong with this picture.

Study of this material isn't my field. But having developed a mathematical approach to artificial intelligence and a model of experimental analysis in Quantum Mechanics that isn't held back by an uncertainty principle, I too get to laugh at big money being wasted because a big name is more important these days than a big idea. I halted my work, partly due to ethical considerations, and partly because it's pointless to continue when nobody will ever see it. Once you fit into this category of neglected researcher for not playing the snob game, it becomes easier to spot others going through the same thing.

If people only knew what a joke it all is. Science is undermined by the same game of wealth and power that corrupts everything else. Ego is the only currency that matters in this world. And people go along with it because they're content to be dogs waiting for their owner to fill a food dish.
